description:
Privilege Escalation — WARN0308

Watches the audit log for DDL that modifies user privileges: GRANT, REVOKE, CREATE USER, ALTER USER, DROP USER, RENAME USER, SET PASSWORD. Fires when performed by an account not in allowed-admin-users.

config_keys.label: Allowed admin users
config_keys.help: Comma-separated list of accounts permitted to execute privilege-changing DDL.

config_keys.label: Timeframe (hours)
config_keys.help: Only audit events within this rolling window are inspected.
